Welcome to The World’s Game. EA SPORTS FC™ 27 launches September 25. Pre-purchase now! https://epic.gm/FC27   

Step into The Grounds to experience a football playground where the streets meet the stadium, and feel greater control in every mode as community-driven innovations deliver more true-to-football gameplay
title: EA SPORTS FC 27 | Pre-purchase Now

author: Epic Games
description:
Phoenix Cyclops, the first DLC character included in the Year 1 Character & Stage Pass, is coming to MARVEL Tōkon: Fighting Souls! https://epic.gm/marvel-tokon

Inspired by his Phoenix Five incarnation from Avengers vs. X-Men, this iconic X-Men leader harnesses the overwhelming power of the Phoenix Force, bringing a fiery new look and devastating abilities to the battlefield. Phoenix Cyclops arrives in Fall 2026. 

Stay tuned for more details on his gameplay and abilities. MARVEL Tōkon: Fighting Souls is coming to PC on August 6, 2026!
title: Marvel Tōkon: Fighting Souls | Phoenix Cyclops
